statement: HBM suppliers sold out their entire 2026 production under non-cancellable contracts, with Micron meeting only 50-66% of customer demand.
why: Fully allocated HBM is a hard supply constraint on AI GPUs.

impact.mechanism: Sold-out HBM limits GPU output regardless of demand.

evidence.excerpt: sold out their entire 2026 production under non-cancellable contracts.
